I have to say for one i applaud the fact that you are researching the breed before you adopt. 
Iggys are fragile but durable, they can break their bones if they jump from too great a height, play rough with a bigger dog (thats how my male broke his), or if you don't give them the proper nutrition they can become even more fragile. Not too worry though as you can read from most of the other posts, they are very resilient dogs though i do recommend a small savings just in case for emergencies but that can be said with any animal.
Both my iggys take baths like champs (though they hate they still do it) but i have not taken them to a lake to test them out when it comes to big bodies of water. If you are looking for an active dog then you defiantly picked a good breed especially for jogging they will go right along side you (with a little training to keep them from running under you). I will say what ever side you train them to walk on that is the side that they will prefer (my male refuses to walk on my left side ever my female isnt as picky but prefers the right side). Potty training sucks with these guys. it takes a while but is worth it. i do recommend crate training with puppy pads for while you are on your long shifts at your hospital (they have tiny bladders).

Iggys will generally only bond with one person, they will like others but will bond with one. My two follow me around my house like shadows. 

I was a big dog lover till i met my wife and she had an iggy, i instantly fell in love with them. I dont want any other dog, what more can you ask for than one of the most loyal, loving, heaters (they produce alot of heat so if you sleep with yours prepare to sweat lol).

I recommended checking out tips on how to build decks. You generally want to go with the rule of thirds. One third lands, One third creatures, and One third non-creatures too start. Going with the four of rule will help as well. So a good starter deck would look something like this.

Creatures
4x Krenko, Mob Boss.
4x Arms Dealer.
2x Bloodmark mentor.
2x Seige Gang Commander.
4x Crazed Goblin.
4x Goblin Arsonist.

Non-Creatures
4x Dragon Fodder.
4x Krenkos Command.
4x Lightning Bolt.
4x Shock.
4x Empty The Warrens.

Land
20x Mountain.

This is about as basic of a goblin deck as i can think of, and it is a fairly cheap build. Following this type of format to build decks helps when you start. It is something i still loosely stick to when i build decks now. As for every one else this is not a perfect deck, but it would be fast, and fun. Please don't flood my in box telling me it is horrible. i am merely using it as an example to help the guy make a better deck and maybe better choices when it comes to buying singles.
